- A bachelor's degree takes 4 years and at least 128 credits in total. [1]
- Your department may require more; its curriculum table has the exact number. [1]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- 12 additional graduation credits are required for overseas students admitted on an equivalent qualification; military training and PE do not count toward these. [1]
- 12 additional graduation credits are required for Hong Kong/Macau students admitted on an equivalent qualification; the same requirement applies to other schools in Taiwan. [1]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- At least 16 credits each semester in the first, second, and third academic years [1]
- At least 9 credits each semester in the fourth academic year [1]

- International students must take the full‑year 5‑credit course “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” (僑生國文) [1]
- International students do not need to take “Chinese (B): Chinese Writing” (國文（B）) [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw [1]

- Take 6 credits of Mandarin courses at the Language Center instead of the first semester. [1]
- File for the Chinese course substitution before you graduate. [1]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Students are required to take five physical education courses in five semesters (Freshman PE I, Freshman PE II, and three PE interest electives) [2]
- The course does not count toward graduation credits [2]
- After completing the five semesters, students may take an additional 1-credit PE course, which also does not count toward graduation credits [2]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw [2]

- A master's degree requires at least 24 credits, not counting thesis credits. [1]
- You must take at least one graduate course of 1 credit or more at NCU; waived courses do not count. [1]

- Students admitted directly into a doctoral program must complete at least 34 credits, including at least 18 doctoral-level credits. [1]
- The credit count does not include dissertation credits. [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Apply before the add/drop deadline of your first semester. [1]
- The application must be submitted to the Language Center before the add/drop deadline of your first semester. [1]
- If approved, you will skip both semesters of Freshman English and receive 6 credits that count toward graduation. [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Undergraduates need at least 100 service hours on the NCU passport before they can receive the degree certificate. [1]
- Check your hours on the Service Learning Website or in the Graduation System. [1]
- If you fail to complete the minimum of 100 service hours, you will not be able to receive the degree certificate. [1]
- For questions, contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心) at https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/. [1]

- Service learning is not listed among the graduation conditions for master's and doctoral students [1]
- The graduation conditions are completing all required courses and credits, passing the degree examination, and receiving a satisfactory conduct grade every semester [1]
- Individual departments may set additional requirements, so contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心) at https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/ [1]

- The service-learning course is required for two semesters with different course numbers. [2]
- The course does not count toward the number of credits for graduation. [2]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [2]

- IELTS score of 5.5 (admitted 115 or later) [2]
- Linguaskill LR score of 145 (admitted 114 or earlier) or 150 (admitted 115 or later) [2]
- BESTEP total score of 700 with listening 90, reading 90, speaking 260, writing 260 [2]

- TOEIC LR: 600 (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- TOEFL ITP: 483 (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- TOEFL IBT: 64 (2026-01-21 起的新制成績為 3.5 級) (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- IELTS: 5.0 (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- GEPT HI First: 143 (admitted 110 or later) [1]
- BESTEP LR: 170 (admitted 110 or later) [1]

- The program requires an English proficiency certificate at CEFR B1 (Threshold) or above. [1]
- Example scores include TOEFL iBT 42; IELTS 4; TOEIC 550; GEPT Intermediate. [2]

- The Ph.D. in Institute of Network Learning Technology is offered by the College of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (資電學院) [1]
- The teaching language is English sufficient [1]
- The program is a 4‑year degree taught in English [1]
- Regulations can be found at https://www.lst.ncu.edu.tw/NLT_new/page.php?slug=method&lang=en [1]

- They are available at 1F, Teaching and Research Building, No. 300, Zhongda Rd., Zhongli District, Taoyuan City 320317 [1]

- Take bus 132 or 133 from any stop on campus towards Zhongli; the ride takes about 20–30 minutes. [1]

- Eligible nationalities: Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand [1]
- Application period is from October 1 to October 22, 2026 [1]

- 勞動部已簡化免附學生證影本等應備文件，僅需檢附護照影本即可申請。 [3]
- 申請流程及注意事項: 僅需檢附護照影本即可送件申請。 [3]
- 勞動部將依據相關規定審查並以核發工作許可，預計每年將有4萬人次僑外學生受惠。 [3]
- 申請進度查詢可於「外國專業人員工作許可申辦網」(https://ezwp.wda.gov.tw)查詢。 [3]

- 畢業後，若欲在臺找工作，可申請以「其他」事由延期居留1年，有必要再申請1次，總延期居留效期最長可達2年。 [1]
- 申請延期居留後，學校會在學生畢業時通報，若未及時變更居留原因，原居留證將被廢止，可能面臨逾期罰鍰或限期出境。 [1]

- 服務時間：8:00至17：00（中午休息時間12：30至13：30） [2]
- 相關檔案：相關連結：(1990 外來人士在臺生活諮詢服務熱線) [1]

- 學士班畢業至少 128 學分 [1]
- 本科學士班畢業至少 128 學分 [1]

- 100 基本時數，否則無法領取學位證書。 [1]
- 可至【服務學習網】或【畢業審核系統】查詢。 [1]
- 如有疑問，請洽學務處服務學習發展中心。 [1]

- 托福 ITP 需達 483 分，適用於 110–114 年入學 [3]
- 依管理學院規章頁的版本標示，送件前請向系所確認適用版本 [3]

- 每年學期 109-110 年自行負擔560 元 [2]
- 國泰人壽保險公司：109-110 年自行負擔560 元 [2]
- 對象：海外直接分發或單招入學，在臺未住滿6個月之僑生 [2]
- 保期：效期6個月 [2]

- 每月1,377元，陸生自付6成（826元）[1]
- 申請資格：衛生福利部112年11月24日公告，內政部移民署許可發給事由為「陸生就學」之中華民國臺灣地區入出境許可證，為全民健康保險法施行細則第8條第1項所稱「經本保險主管機關認定得在臺灣地區長期居留之證明文件」並自113年2月1日起，持事由為「陸生就學」之入出境許可證入臺之陸生，應依法參加全民健康保險[1]

- 在校內任一公車站搭 132 或 133 往中壢，車程約 20–30 分鐘。 [2]

- 2年需經合作企業評核通過後核發，並需依合作企業要進行實習。 [2]
